summary: Smart Order Alert extension fully tested. Backend: 24/24 pytest cases passed (auth, accept/reject/modify/confirm-modified, status PUT extended, regression, public track w/ extended fields). Frontend: admin login + /admin/orders verified (audio element, ringing-indicator, all status filters incl accepted/rejected, polling 4s confirmed, accept/reject/modify modals all functional, mute toggle present). Customer /track/{id} verified for pending/accepted/rejected/modified+accepted with correct banners + UPDATED tag; 5s polling confirmed.

issues: Default placeholder/hint shows 'admin@karachinaseeb.com / admin123' but the actual seeded admin is 'admin@restaurant.com'. Cosmetic/copy bug — login still works because user can type the right value, but the 'Default: ...' helper text is misleading.
Right-card 'Status: PENDING' shows the payment_status; can be confusing for customers since the top banner already states the order status. Consider relabeling to 'Payment Status'.

action_items: (LOW) Update admin login helper text from 'admin@karachinaseeb.com' to 'admin@restaurant.com' to match the actual seed.
(LOW) On TrackingPage, the right-side 'Status' label refers to payment status — consider 'Payment Status' to avoid confusion with the live order status banner.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3079 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into routers (auth, menu, online_orders, online_orders_alerts, tracking, admin).
ObjectId handling is consistent: _serialize_online_order pops _id correctly. Public /api/track endpoint also uses str(o['_id']). Good.
asyncio.create_task(send_whatsapp(...)) is fire-and-forget without keeping a reference — minor: tasks can be GC'd if event loop is idle. Low risk for current usage.
/api/online-orders/pending-count returns 401 (auth missing) — good. Endpoint correctly admin-gated.
modify endpoint correctly preserves discount_amount + delivery_fee in _recalculate_totals. Good design.
Frontend AdminOrders.jsx is 573 lines — borderline acceptable; consider extracting RejectModal and ModifyModal into separate files.

manageAlertSound works, but mute does not set el.muted=true (only el.pause()). If a polling cycle interleaves between setMuted(true) and the effect run, audio may briefly resume — minor; UX is fine because the muted state takes effect on the very next manageAlertSound() call (immediate via useEffect dep [muted]). Implementation looks correct.
seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_ prefixed online orders during testing for accept/reject/modify flows. They are tagged with names beginning with TEST_ and customer_name 'TEST_*' so they can be identified for cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Smart Order Alert features (accept/reject/modify/confirm-modified + WhatsApp fire-and-forget + customer tracking page with new statuses) are verified end-to-end. Twilio creds are intentionally empty so send_whatsapp() silently no-ops — this is expected (NOT a bug). Both polling cadences match spec: admin POS pending-count = 4s, customer tracking = 5s. Use /app/backend/tests/test_smart_alert.py as regression suite for future iterations.
